# Monterey Bay Door

> Commercial doors, frames, hardware, & access control specialist serving Central California. Complete turnkey solutions and in-house locksmithing. Authorized Dugmore & Duncan / ASSA ABLOY distributor providing direct vendor pricing, professional installation, and ongoing service for hotels, colleges, and commercial buildings.

## Company
- Founded: 2007
- Address: 1630 Lana Way Bldg B, Hollister, CA 95023
- Phone: (831) 757-1878
- Email: bids@mbdoor.com
- 30+ years combined experience in construction and access control
- Licensed, bonded and insured

## Services
- Custom wood and commercial door sales
- Door machining (including customer-supplied doors)
- Custom trim and millwork supply
- Commercial access control systems
- Electronic lock installation
- Card reader and mobile access systems
- Commercial door hardware supply and installation
- Exit device installation
- High-security cylinder and key systems
- Door closer installation and service
- Electric strike and maglock systems
- Master key system design
- Commercial security maintenance and service

## Service area
- Monterey Bay
- Central Coast
- San Benito County
- Monterey County
- Santa Cruz County
- Salinas Valley
- Silicon Valley
- Central Valley (Fresno, Visalia)
- Central California

## Brands and partners
- Brands: Sargent, Corbin Russwin, Medeco, HES, Securitron, McKinney, Pemko, Keedex, Centrios, Accentra/Yale
- Partners: Dugmore & Duncan (authorized distributor), ASSA ABLOY, Allegion, TM Cobb, Metrie (El & El), Kelleher, Ironwood Door, ABS (American Building Supply), DCI Hollow Metal, Orepac
